title: Sirhan Sirhan as an MK Ultra subject linked to William Joseph Bryan

tellings.quote: Sirhan Sirhan himself was an MK Ultra patient because he had spent some time with William Jennings Brian

plain: Sirhan Sirhan, the man convicted of killing Robert F. Kennedy in 1968, was a subject of MK Ultra, the CIA's secret mind-control research, Michels says, because he had spent time with the hypnotist William Joseph Bryan (Michels slips and says "William Jennings Bryan"). Michels gives this as his own reading, and if true it would mean the assassin had been worked on by someone linked to CIA mind-control efforts.
